contentText:
It's hard to believe, but Grand Theft Auto VI is now a real thing that we all can play . Thirteen years after GTA V , and eight years since Red Dead Redemption 2 , Rockstar is back with its latest sprawling, extravagant open world. There's a lot to experience - and a lot to talk about.

Perhaps the most impressive thing about GTA VI is how flexible it is, letting you mold the experience to your own play style. You can still be a maniacal criminal, but you can also focus on the new love story that includes an entire button dedicated to holding hands. Or you can spend the hours fishing or driving around listening to the radio. Maybe you just want …
